narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic vent and commentary regarding the perceived unfairness of the rating and reporting system in the game 'Arena of Valor'. By contrasting his own active play with an AFK teammate who received a higher score, the creator aims to entertain his audience while promoting his social media profile.
